_doc: Back of the Envelope (the what-if channel): graphite and marker. Read by kits/cinema/film/page.mjs (tokens → --<name>, roles → --hud-<role>, fonts → @font-face, type → --font-<role>, safe, captionY, cssText) and by kits/cinema/sci/contrast.py. Hexes are the bible's (films/channels/whatif/bible.md §1). Marker (violet-magenta) is the calculation and the spoken word; assume (tally green) is assumptions only; anchor (ballpoint blue) is the human-scale anchor only. 'bg' is an alias of 'graphite' for the page. Sizes are px at 1080×1920; the roles carry the same sizes in vmin (px / 10.8). Not Lumevina, not Los Güeros, not Claude coral, and none of the sibling channels' hues: contrast.py checks the distances.
name: Back of the Envelope
promise: Impossible questions, honest assumptions, real calculations.

scene._doc: 3D only. The world is drawn as a chalk-and-graphite model on graph paper under one warm-white desk light, plus a 6% graphite hemisphere fill. Line work is chalk; the calculation's own marks (the graph, the boxed answer, the core at the payoff) are marker; the falling figure is anchor blue. Nothing blooms except the marker core at the payoff (threshold 0.9); text never does.

highlight._doc: The word being spoken turns marker (the colour of the calculation) on the plate; words still to come are chalk-2, words said are chalk.

type._doc: Display: Bricolage Grotesque 700 at its narrow width (wdth 80, opsz 96; set in cssText) for titles and the boxed answer. Text: Figtree 700 captions, 600 labels. Mono: JetBrains Mono for the spine readout, badges and counters (monospaced, so figures never jitter; code ligatures off). Hand: Caveat, only for scribbles on the envelope (never captions, never a number the viewer must read). The label glyphs ≈ ∵ ◆ are drawn from JetBrains Mono (it has all three), never from Inter.

sizes._doc: px at 1080×1920. Captions: at most 2 lines of at most 24 characters (kits/cinema/script pages them with max_chars = 24); 56 px is the largest whole px at which the widest 24-character row of episode 1 fits the plate's maximum width (0.72 × W = 778 px) in Figtree 700 without hud.js shrinking it (measured in Chromium, see PRODUCTION.md). Labels: the pill is at least 0.035 × H = 67 px tall.

labels._doc: Each pill carries a glyph as well as its colour, so colour is never the only cue: ◆ anchor (the human-scale thing), ∵ assumption, ≈ estimate; plain chalk pills (no glyph, bar mark) name parts of the world.

part.use: parts of the world: crust, mantle, core, tunnel

anchor.use: the human-scale anchor: you, a car, a city

assume.use: an assumption the number depends on

calc.use: a computed value in the world (a speed, a peak)

contrast._doc: What contrast.py checks besides the automatic pairs. grounds: the flat colours text can sit on. behind: what the plate, pills and badges can sit over (worst case first: the chalk model at full lamp, then the lamp pool, then the ground).

pairs.note: dark text on a marker chip (the boxed answer's tag)
the spine readout's live term on its bar
the graph on the paper, the box

motif.signature_shape: The boxed answer: the final number boxed with a hand-drawn marker rectangle, as a student boxes an answer. One per episode; a box around '≈' is the avatar. Space owns the ring, body the pulse line, physics the strobe ladder; this channel owns the box.
motif.spine: The running sum: a bar at y 250–330 that writes the calculation term by term in JetBrains Mono. The live term is marker, finished terms chalk, assumptions carry a green ∵ tag. It holds its answer, lit and boxed, through the whoa and the takeaway, and its label says what the number means.
motif.honesty_badges: JetBrains Mono, assume green: '∵ no air', '∵ uniform Earth', '≈ estimate', 'thought experiment', 'not to scale', 'time ×N', 'rounded', 'idealised'. One tier below labels.
motif.title_card: A band at y 250–470: an envelope flap folds down on the first pluck, BACK OF THE ENVELOPE in Bricolage caps, the question in Figtree below.
motif.end_card: The boxed answer, large, 'Next envelope: …' below, the episode's footnote fact. Held ≥ 1.5 s.
motif.recurring_segment: Show your work: the whole sum on one line with its assumptions and the sensitivity row.
motif.colour_rules: Marker is the calculation (the spoken word, the live term, the box). Green is an assumption, only. Blue is the human-scale anchor, only. The world itself is chalk and graphite.
motif.sound: D lydian at 90 BPM (a 16th is 5 frames); pizzicato plucks and pencil foley; signature plucks D5, A5, G♯5, 5 frames apart.
